description:
Functional specifications / files: extend lib/zaq/channels/delivery/preparation.ex and add Channel-local execution state only as needed. Reuse acquire/3, Materialization and Attachments.validate_group/2 / validate_upload_group/2. Cache successful and failed acquisition once per original index per attempt; preserve fixed group indices and immutable source Records/Plan. Prepare upload batches or direct-send requests through bridge seams; release bytes/prepared payloads once no remaining step needs them. Direct-send abort prepares all candidates before publication; upload mode prepares/acquires groupwise and finishes required uploads before publication.
Tests before implementation: group/batch ordering, shared-index acquisition once, cached denial once, later preparation failure with abort gives no publication, continue keeps usable files or text-only answer, byte drift and exact bounds, cleanup and concurrent-attempt isolation. Property tests for stable indices and no duplicated acquisition. Nil identity never expands access; pass only trusted materialization context.
Branches: direct-send/upload modes, abort/continue, empty/partial usable sets, raw/base64 content, invalid prepared payload, unknown optional limits.
Mocking: real internal materialization/permission path; stub external retrieval/transport only, inject runtime config. Coordinate tasks with messages.
Documentation: Preparation docs, docs/services/channels.md.
Action reuse: extend existing preparation owner; reuse acquisition and group validation rather than parallel helpers or a new Action. Prepared content is transient local state, never Engine history. Consumption by executor only; adapter owns encoding/provider details.

Implementation rules: Read AGENTS.md, docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md, docs/action-reuse.md, docs/testing-approach.md, docs/conventions.md and docs/code-quality.md plus the owning service guide before work. Reference ../zaq-feat-channel-files is behavioral evidence, not code to copy wholesale. Preserve Outgoing.attachments and separate metadata-only Plan; PR2 FileSettings/resolver remain authoritative. Keep existing test behavior unless its exact change is explicitly approved; add new tests for the new grouped evidence contract. No PR6 Agent selection/AttachDocuments or PR7 workflow/notification implementation. Unit/integration/property/LiveView tests are immediate; new feature E2E belongs to the gated finalization task. Validation follows docs/WORKFLOW_AGENT.md; no per-step numerical coverage gate.

comments.text:
Module-context investigation complete before edits (A-J):
A/B mental model/responsibility: Preparation.acquire/3 owns trusted per-Record acquisition/decoding/raw limits; Attachments owns metadata packing/group byte checks; Plan owns immutable fixed refs/graph; bridges own encoding/provider mechanics; Executor will own policy/order/effects.
C dependencies: Materialization and TrustedContext (authorization/event boundary), DecodeBase64 via validated Jido.Exec (decoding), Attachments/TransportRequirements (pure limits). Dependencies are per-request context; no new global selection/configuration.
D contracts: acquire returns transient content/size/name/MIME or error. Existing CommunicationBridge has no preparation callbacks; add optional prepare_upload_request/2 and prepare_delivery_message/3 seams returning exact prepared map with size_bytes. No requirements resolver added.
E state ownership: new private Preparation struct scoped to one invocation, containing indexed source Records, success/error cache, prepared payloads, remaining metadata steps, safe-coded failures and trusted context. Never persisted or put into Outgoing/Plan. No process/global state.
F flows: start validates metadata/count/requirements -> acquire_group redeems each original index once -> existing group validation -> prepare_step delegates exact encoding and checks size -> release_step removes prepared data and acquired bytes after final byte consumer -> close clears transient state. Upload mode byte consumers are upload steps; publication uses provider refs. Direct-send consumers retain bytes through final header/body re-encoding and release after publication.
G invariants: unchanged source Records/Plan, fixed refs, nil identity no bypass, denial cached once, continue retains usable files/text fallback and failure facts, abort cannot publish via preparation, unknown optional ceilings stay unknown, requests re-encoded when inputs change.
H risks: prepared maps are opaque; bridge size honesty needs real wire proof in zaq-9j8.5. Never keep a cached request across changed thread/body inputs. Failed file never counts as published.
I coverage: existing preparation tests prove signed-handle identity/bypass/canonical denial, raw/base64, metadata/size drift. Add attempt-cache/group/size/lifetime/properties and request-seam tests; integration proves abort no publication in executor task.
J unknowns: real chat/SMTP exact prepared forms and adapter compatibility remain gated by .5; no inferred support or pin changes.
Action reuse rechecked: extend Preparation and optional existing CommunicationBridge interface; reuse acquire/3, Materialization, Attachments.validate_group/2/validate_upload_group/2. Local-only runtime infrastructure, no Action/tool, no duplicated resolver/redemption. Existing test expectations unchanged in this task.

Completed attempt-local Preparation state and optional existing CommunicationBridge request-encoding seams. Plan and resolved requirements validate before acquisition; each original index caches successful/failed acquire exactly once through existing signed Materialization/TrustedContext. Fixed group/raw-upload checks reused; continue retains usable indices or text fallback failures, abort returns before encoding/publication. Exact prepared size_bytes checked on every call, including changed body/thread headers. Duplicate/foreign indices rejected before encoding. release_step drops prepared requests and acquired bytes after upload/direct-send consumers; close clears transient inputs/context. No publication or new resolver/Action/persistence. Existing acquire/3 test semantics preserved. Validation: TDD red; 63 focused new/existing cases passed (8 properties). Final attempt-suite rerun 12 passed (1 property), final mix q passed after extracting one nested reducer branch. Real materialization security tests and nil-identity case preserved. Wire accuracy/adapter facts remain .5; executor owns the cross-group abort/no-publication integration proof in .4. No commits/pushes/merges/publication; no feature E2E authoring.
